title: CFAPI Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced **CFAPI Specialist** with deep, hands-on expertise in Microsoft's Windows Cloud Files API (CFAPI) and the development of cloud-based file synchronization solutions. This position requires a specialist who has designed, developed, debugged, and maintained Windows file sync clients—not merely a general C# or Windows application developer.

The ideal candidate will have strong proficiency in C#, Windows APIs, P/Invoke, native interop, asynchronous programming, multithreading, and Windows file-system concepts. The candidate should have practical experience implementing cloud-backed files, placeholder management, on-demand file hydration and dehydration, synchronization state management, and reliable communication between Windows clients and cloud storage services.

You will be responsible for building robust, scalable, and high-performance file synchronization capabilities, troubleshooting complex file-system issues, and ensuring reliable synchronization across local Windows environments and remote storage platforms.

**Key Responsibilities:-**

1. Windows Cloud Files API (CFAPI) Development

* Design, develop, and maintain Windows-based file synchronization clients using Microsoft's Cloud Files API.
* Implement and manage Sync Root registration, connection lifecycle, synchronization callbacks, and cloud-backed file operations.
* Work extensively with CFAPI functions, including:
* CfRegisterSyncRoot
* CfConnectSyncRoot
* CfCreatePlaceholders
* CfExecute
* CfHydratePlaceholder
* CfDehydratePlaceholder
* CfSetPinState
* CfSetInSyncState
* Implement placeholder creation, metadata management, hydration and dehydration workflows, and synchronization state transitions.
* Develop and maintain callback handlers for operations such as FETCH\_DATA and FETCH\_PLACEHOLDERS.
* Implement pinning and unpinning functionality to manage local file availability and cloud-backed storage behavior.
* Ensure correct handling of callback execution, request completion, cancellation, and error conditions.

2. Cloud Storage and File Synchronization

* Build reliable synchronization mechanisms between Windows clients and cloud-based storage or backend services.
* Implement on-demand file access, remote content retrieval, local file availability, and synchronization status updates.
* Handle file uploads, downloads, metadata synchronization, and synchronization conflict scenarios as required.
* Ensure consistency between local file-system states and remote storage metadata.
* Design mechanisms for retry handling, recovery from interrupted operations, and synchronization resumption following network or application failures.
* Integrate file synchronization components with REST APIs and cloud storage services.

3. C#, Windows APIs, and Native Interoperability

* Develop production-grade applications and services using C# and the .NET ecosystem.
* Integrate managed code with native Windows APIs using P/Invoke and interoperability techniques.
* Work with native data structures, delegates, callbacks, handles, memory management, and API error codes.
* Diagnose issues arising from managed/native boundaries, resource management, and API lifecycle handling.
* Apply sound software design principles to develop maintainable, testable, and reliable Windows client components.
* Collaborate with engineering teams on API contracts, architecture decisions, and implementation strategies.

4. Windows File-System Internals

* Apply a strong understanding of Windows and NTFS file-system behavior to file synchronization development.
* Troubleshoot file locking, sharing violations, access permissions, open handles, reparse points, and file operation failures.
* Understand placeholder behavior, file attributes, directory enumeration, file metadata, and file-system state transitions.
* Investigate issues involving concurrent file access, hydration failures, interrupted operations, and local-versus-cloud state inconsistencies.
* Ensure synchronization operations behave reliably under real-world Windows usage conditions.

5. Asynchronous Programming and Concurrency

* Design asynchronous workflows for file hydration, content retrieval, synchronization callbacks, and background operations.
* Implement multithreaded processing with appropriate synchronization primitives and thread-safety controls.
* Handle cancellation tokens, timeouts, retries, race conditions, deadlocks, and resource contention.
* Ensure callbacks and asynchronous operations complete within the required lifecycle and API constraints.
* Optimize concurrent file operations without compromising data integrity or application stability.

6. Troubleshooting, Debugging, and Performance Optimization

* Investigate complex synchronization failures, placeholder errors, file access issues, and connectivity-related defects.
* Perform root-cause analysis using application logs, diagnostic tools, debugger traces, and Windows system information.
* Use Visual Studio debugging and, where appropriate, WinDbg to diagnose application crashes, hangs, and native interop issues.
* Analyze performance bottlenecks in file enumeration, hydration, metadata processing, and synchronization workflows.
* Improve throughput, responsiveness, memory usage, resource utilization, and recovery behavior.
* Develop preventive fixes and regression tests to reduce recurring production incidents.

7. Testing, Code Quality, and Production Support

* Develop unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for CFAPI components and synchronization workflows.
* Validate placeholder lifecycle operations, file state transitions, network interruption recovery, and concurrency scenarios.
* Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical documentation, and engineering design discussions.
* Maintain existing production applications through defect resolution, performance tuning, and reliability improvements.
* Support releases, investigate production incidents, and collaborate with QA, backend, and infrastructure teams.
* Document technical designs, known limitations, troubleshooting procedures, and operational guidelines.

Mandatory Skills and Qualifications

Candidates must have demonstrable, hands-on experience in the following areas:

* **Professional Experience:** 7–8+ years of software development experience, preferably focused on Windows desktop applications, system-level development, or file synchronization products.
* **CFAPI Expertise:** Practical experience developing applications using Microsoft's Windows Cloud Files API.
* **CFAPI Functions:** Working knowledge of Sync Root registration and connection, placeholder creation, callback handling, hydration/dehydration, pin-state management, and synchronization state updates.
* **File Synchronization Solutions:** Proven experience building or maintaining cloud drive clients, file sync engines, or cloud-backed Windows file systems.
* **C# and .NET:** Strong programming skills in C# and experience developing reliable, production-grade Windows applications.
* **Windows APIs:** Hands-on experience with Windows APIs, native interop, and Windows-specific application behavior.
* **P/Invoke and Interoperability:** Practical experience integrating managed C# code with native Windows functions and data structures.
* **Windows File-System Concepts:** Strong understanding of NTFS, file handles, file locking, reparse points, file attributes, and access permissions.
* **Asynchronous Programming:** Experience with asynchronous workflows, task-based programming, cancellation, exception handling, and reliable background operations.
* **Multithreading and Concurrency:** Ability to diagnose and resolve race conditions, deadlocks, thread-safety issues, and concurrent file access problems.
* **Debugging and Troubleshooting:** Strong diagnostic skills using Visual Studio and Windows debugging tools to resolve complex production issues.
* **Cloud Storage Integration:** Experience integrating Windows clients with cloud storage platforms, backend services, or REST APIs.
* **Software Engineering Practices:** Proficiency in version control, code reviews, automated testing, documentation, and production support.

**Important:** This is a specialized CFAPI engineering position. Candidates with only general C#, .NET, Windows desktop development, or API development experience—but no practical CFAPI or cloud file synchronization experience—may not be suitable.

Good-to-Have Skills

* Experience developing OneDrive-like cloud drive applications or enterprise file synchronization clients.
* Familiarity with Windows Shell integration and File Explorer experiences.
* Experience with C++, Win32 programming, and native Windows debugging.
* Knowledge of Windows Services and background processing architectures.
* Experience with WinDbg, dump analysis, and advanced crash diagnostics.
* Understanding of file-system notifications and change tracking.
* Experience designing synchronization conflict resolution and recovery mechanisms.
* Exposure to distributed systems, large-scale Windows client applications, and enterprise cloud storage platforms.
* Experience with performance profiling, memory diagnostics, and reliability engineering.

Pay: ₹1,600,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

title: Senior Solutions Architect – AI Infrastructure Networking (remote in India)
description:
**Company Description**

**About Mirantis**

Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/

 **Job Description**

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with deep networking expertise to join the Voyager team in the Mirantis Office of the CTO. You will own the network solutioning of k0rdent AI, our platform for building and operating GPU clouds and AI factories, from metal to model.

You will design how large GPU clusters are interconnected, how tenants are isolated, and how workloads reach the network from containers, virtual machines and bare metal nodes. You will turn that design into published reference architectures, working code and proofs of concept that run on real hardware with our customers and partners.

As part of the Office of the CTO, research is a core part of the job. You will explore designs and technologies before customers ask for them, prototype ideas that may not ship, and challenge established practice when a better approach exists. Your work will shape where k0rdent AI goes next, not only how it is deployed today.

This role combines research with hands-on, outward-facing work. You will split your time between exploring new designs, writing architecture, building and validating it in the lab, and explaining it to engineers, executives and conference audiences. You will work with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering colleagues across many countries and time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Reference architecture

* Design and publish network reference architectures and solution designs for k0rdent AI, covering data center topologies from a single rack to multi-thousand-GPU clusters.
* Define compute (east-west) fabrics on InfiniBand and on RoCEv2 Ethernet, including rail-optimised and fat-tree / Clos designs, oversubscription and failure-domain choices.
* Define front-end, storage and management networks, and how they connect to customer data centers, public clouds and hybrid environments.
* Specify multi-tenant isolation across the stack: InfiniBand partitions (PKeys), VRFs and EVPN-VXLAN on Ethernet, and Kubernetes-level network policy.
* Document scale limits and trade-offs (cost, performance, operability, vendor lock-in) with defensible reasoning a customer can follow.

Host and platform networking

* Define how Linux hosts expose NICs, DPUs and SuperNICs to workloads: PCI passthrough, SR-IOV virtual functions, IOMMU groups, NUMA and GPU-NIC affinity.
* Design Kubernetes networking for AI workloads: primary and secondary CNIs, Multus, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, NVIDIA Network Operator, and Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA).
* Design networking for virtual machines on KubeVirt, including passthrough and SR-IOV for GPU and RDMA traffic.

Research and exploration

* Track and evaluate emerging technologies and standards in AI networking, such as Ultra Ethernet (UEC), SuperNIC and DPU offloads, scale-up and scale-across fabrics, and Kubernetes DRA network drivers.
* Prototype alternative designs in the lab, including ones customers have not yet asked for, and measure them against current practice.
* Challenge established or customer-preferred designs when evidence points to a better option, and make the case with data.
* Publish findings as internal research notes and design proposals and, where appropriate, as external papers, blog posts or talks.

Code and proofs of concept

* Build and run proofs of concept with customers and partners, on Mirantis lab hardware and on customer sites, and report results against agreed success criteria.
* Write automation and tooling (Python, Go, Bash, Ansible, Helm, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform) that makes the reference architectures reproducible.
* Run validation and benchmarking of fabrics and host configurations (e.g. NCCL tests, perftest, ib\_write\_bw) and turn findings into design guidance.

Customers, partners and community

* Act as the network subject matter expert in customer discovery, design reviews and architecture workshops, bringing thought leadership and new ideas rather than only reflecting current practice.
* Work with hardware and networking partners (e.g. NVIDIA, server OEMs, switch and network vendors) on joint designs and validations.
* Innovate and feed research results back to Product and Engineering, and help shape the k0rdent AI roadmap.
* Present at industry events, webinars and partner summits, and run hands-on workshops for technical audiences.
* Write technical content: reference architecture documents, solution briefs, blog posts and internal enablement.

 **Qualifications**

Education and experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years in network engineering or network architecture, with at least 3 years in data center, HPC or cloud infrastructure networking.
* Customer-facing experience as a solutions architect, pre-sales engineer, consultant or technical lead.

Required technical skills

* Data center network design: spine-leaf and Clos topologies, rail-optimised GPU fabrics, oversubscription, ECMP, and the operational challenges of scaling to thousands of nodes.
* InfiniBand: subnet management, partitioning, adaptive routing, and how NCCL / RDMA traffic behaves on the fabric.
* RoCEv2 on Ethernet: lossless and congestion-controlled designs (PFC, ECN, DCQCN), QoS, MTU and buffer tuning.

We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.  

  

This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Delivery \& stakeholder ownership** — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* **Hands\-on technical leadership \& design** — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* **Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence** — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* **AI\-assisted engineering** — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* **SE \+ SQE leadership** — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* **People management \& culture** — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.
